Just got started on it this weekend, it's still in alpha so it only cost 19.99 off of steam. Overall pretty fun!

It's a survival game, so it's kind of like H1Z1, Rust, and Minecraft all rolled into one. Start out on the beach with a wooden club and loin cloth, and get started. Can mine resources then build your own shack/castle or whatever, but beware of other players, cause around a third of them will Kill you On Sight (KoS). Players are also capable of building siege weapons like trebuchets to take down other players establishments.

Getting a guild together to protect your building is important, as it can be attacked even while you're not online (and your character itself murdered while you're logged out), but if people are always around building and adding you should theoretically be fine.

Overall, tons of fun, but I wish something could be done so I'm not starting completely from scratch each day I log in. Anyone else on Voat started in this game and interested in forming a clan? Just looking for some friendly people to build with right now.
